experiment.comment: Too few data points in the data series, therefore no appropriate fitting could be carried out when using Minimal Spline Fit. The measurement-specific standard deviation (5%) is used for std_fit.
The experimental data for NH3/O2/He originally published in the SM are wrong. I requested the correct data from Yuyang Li's group, and they sent it to me by email.
